name: oxford_flowers102
description: Oxford Flowers 102 is a fine-grained image classification benchmark containing 102 flower categories with photographs exhibiting large variations in scale, pose, and lighting. It is commonly used to evaluate visual recognition models' ability to discriminate among many visually similar classes and to test transfer learning and fine-grained feature representations.
reputation: Widely used and well-established benchmark for fine-grained visual classification and transfer learning in the computer vision community.
